notes.title: New Release: Death and the Fly
notes.notes:
Death and the Fly is now available on Steam.

In this unique 2D platform puzzle game players will control two very different characters, Death and the Fly. Each character has special skills that must be used to navigate the many traps and puzzles contained in each level. With many interesting ways to die and numerous opponents to face, the player will be challenged and entertained for hours.
